stem:
Dev tries to hold his breath while counting slowly during music class. After a short time he has to breathe again.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Holding the breath soon becomes difficult because the body needs oxygen from the air to keep working.
Holding the breath soon becomes difficult because the body needs nitrogen from the air.
Humans cannot survive for even a few minutes without oxygen.

teacher.key_rationale: Statements 1 and 3 correctly link breath-holding difficulty and short survival without air to the body's need for oxygen. Statement 2 wrongly names nitrogen instead of oxygen.
